notes.title: Update 1.1.9
notes.content:
Fixed crash on some video cards.
Reduced application size.
Minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.1.816
notes.content: The English localization has been changed, [b]Snufflegrunt[/b] helped with this, thanks!

notes.title: Update 1.1.815
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to disable camera shake.
[*] Added the ability to disable damage.
[*] Added auto-detection of settings for SteamDeck.
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Optimization
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the "freezes in the main menu" bug. Freezes have previously occurred with some settings.
[*] Dynamic reflections have been optimized.
[*] Post effects have been optimized.
[*] Fixed a bug with shadows turned off. Previously, when shadows were turned off, only the outline was displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.725
notes.content:
[h2]Сar shader:[/h2]
The car shader has been modified, providing a significantly greater variety of paint options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250685/6d550174d36553b8baefb2a9feaaf9d1e5ea32e0.png[/img]

The logic for car paint and decals has been changed, allowing you to give your car a unique appearance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250685/ab8637ffdda7031a3b7059bbe6e2abf3b67d3a03.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250685/598213798926e4dfc91ff142d24983989d37a85c.png[/img]

[h2]Also in this update:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ultra-wide monitor support has been added.
[*] Winnings for all races have been increased, making it easier to purchase cars and upgrades.
[*] The rearview function has been fixed, and the camera now changes direction instantly.
[*] A "Motion Blur" effect has been added.
[/list]

notes.title: Nominate "First Racer"!
notes.content: Nominate the "First Racer" in the “Better with friends” category.

notes.title: Update 1.1.511
notes.content:
In update 1.1.511, the graphics type has been greatly redesigned, necessary for future updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250685/f4d1a5e5765e30b7a2784f352ba69dd08025fdad.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added outline effect (Can be turned off in the game settings).
[*] Added improved smoke effect.
[*] Improved car shader.
[*] Improved physics of SUVs.
[*] Added "look back", default button ["V" (Keyboard)/D-pad down (Gamepad)].
[*] Motion blur effect is temporarily disabled.
[*] Fixed minor bugs in car models.
[/list]

[i]Thank you all for your reviews and feedback, there will be more to come.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.1.425
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The beginning of the game has been changed: now, when you first start it, you have the opportunity to buy the first car and drive the first race in it.
[*] The Jumper's suspension settings have been changed.
[*] Fixing minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.415
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new car "Jumper".
[*] The balance of "Driving Test" races has been changed.
[*] Changed camera logic.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.401
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Added online multiplayer. Play with friends, in all FirstRacer modes, earn experience, have fun.
[*] Added 5 new cars.
[*] Improved drift physics. Now drifting has become more comfortable.
[*] Added Custom Game.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.515
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Added local multiplayer for 2-4 players.
[*]Improved drift assistant, assistant can be turned on / off in the control settings.
[*]Simplified AI for drifting on medium and easy difficulty.
[*]Optimized graphics in local multiplayer.
[*]Fixed minor bugs in the vehicle selection menu.
[*]Minor changes to visual effects when hitting a car.
[*]The power of cars in test races has been reduced, now these races have become easier.
[*]Added new achievements for local multiplayer.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.501
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Improved progress saving system.
[*] Improved detailing of all locations.
[*] Improved lighting.
[*] Improved vehicle shadows and reflections.
[*] Increased number of physics passes per second.
[*] Changed locations colliders.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.102
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reduced AI difficulty on easy and medium difficulty.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed dynamic reflection for S34 car.
[*] Fixed other issues with dynamic reflections.
[*] Now the FPS counter is displayed in the main menu (If this option is enabled).
[*] Fixed being able to make infinite drift points.
[*] The save logic has been slightly changed, now the backup copy is saved separately.
[/list]
